role: Value type pairing a HealthKit quantity value with its sample's start/end window, unit-agnostic; used by the Health rebuild/import code and ActivityBoutResolver.
types: HealthSampleWindow: struct (Sendable, Equatable) — start, end, value
toplevel: Stored lets start, end, value; synthesized Equatable.

units.does: Returns end − start in seconds (negative if end precedes start).
Memberwise init storing start, end and value.
